findings.description: The requirement specifies behavior at exact equality and names test as its verification method, but CON-SUP-127 requires verification margins of at least 200 µs on either side of the limit. A test using those margins cannot establish the equality behavior.
findings.requested_change: Resolve how exact-equality behavior is to be verified under CON-SUP-127 and specify the resulting verification conditions and method.
